# Diagnostic code registry (MOD-003).
#
# Every diagnostic code that has been merged to main, and therefore shipped
# by the next release, is listed here with its status:
#
#   active   the code is emitted by its module and documented in docs/SPEC.md
#   retired  the check was removed; the code stays reserved and must never be
#            emitted again, but keeps its row in docs/SPEC.md marked retired
#
# This file is append-only. Adding a code appends an `active` line; removing a
# check flips its line to `retired`. A line is never deleted or renumbered.
# src/result/codes_lifecycle_test.go enforces this against the sources and
# the spec.
